{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify QA orders are present (6 rows)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Now compute conversion rate over ALL rows (per contract: population = all rows)
# Conversion rate = (converted == 1) / (all orders) by segment
conversion_rate_all = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rates by segment (using all rows in population):")
print(conversion_rate_all)

# Find segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rate_all.idxmax()
print("Highest conversion rate segment:", highest_segment)

# Output the result
conversion_rate_all"}
